posts.name: Oaktree
posts.cooked:
See the main Sentinels Deckbuilding thread for the rules and intial two games.  In general it's select up to four hero decks to build a single hero deck out of.  It (and others) will then face a similarly constructed villain deck.  Heroes are 2-0 so far, but villain constructers have also so far resisted the desire to build an unwinnable game as well.

Environment for this game will be one of these three: The Block, Time Cataclysm, or Realm of Discord.  To selected at random at game start.

Hero Roster (will be updated) - underlined hero is the character card being used

grysql - Naturalist; Sentinels; Chrono-Ranger; Legacy

BH Meerkat - Ra; Absolute Zero; Mr Fixer; Wraith

phantaskippy - Omnitron-X; Tachyon; Parse; Haka

luminos - Unity, Expatriette, Argent Adept, Nightmist

 

Unclaimed Heroes: Bunker; Fanatic; KNYFE; The Scholar; Setback; Tempest; Visionary

Realizing that while the people of Earth are distracted by the Oscars and various other enterprises
Maria Helena Teresa Servanda Jimena Paterna Domenga Gabrielle Placia Sendina Belita Eufemia Columba
Gontina Amina Mafalda Cristina Rainek De Falcon had decided that the time is ripe to emerge from the seas
of time and loot some new iPhones.

LA COMMODORA! (advanced)

HP: 75

In Play: La Paradoja Magnifica [15]

Trash:  NONE

-------------------------
Start of Turn:


Play a Card:
Temporal Thief - Put the top card of each hero deck under the villain character card
                 Deal each hero target 1 psychic damage

End of Turn:  
LA COMMODORA deals Ra 3 projectile damage
Play Gene-Bound Guard

-------------------------
HP:  75
Under Villain Card:
(Ultimate Target), (Onboard Module Installation), (Accelerated Assault), (Unity Card)

In Play:  
La Paradoja Magnifica [15]
Gene-Bound Guard [3]

Trash:  
Temporal Thief
-------------------------
Effects:

Start:  
-  If there are 3 or more cards under the character card, flip the villain character card (LC)
-  Destroy a hero ongoing or equipment card (LC)
-  Shuffle the villain trash into the villain deck. (La Pa Mag)

End:
- Deal the hero target with the highest HP 3 projectile damage (LC)
- Play the top card of the villain deck (La Pa Mag)

Static:
- Whenever a hero card is destroyed by a villain card, put it under the villain character card (LC)
- Reduce damage dealt to villain targets by 1 (Gene-bound Guard)
 
===========

posts.cooked:
Supply crate goes under La Capitan. And I’ll actually be using Expatriettes character card. Quick rules question: would arcane cadence get around the restriction of playing golems during play phase?

Expatriette

HP: 28

Hand: Brainstorm, Bee Bot, Arcane Cadence, Arcane Cadence

In Play:

Trash:

Start of Turn:

Play a Card: Arcane Cadence (reveals: raptor bot, robot reclamation, mistbound, supply crate, arcane cadence. Arcane cadence goes to hand, raptor bot goes in the trash, robot reclamation goes on top of deck, supply crate goes to the bottom of the deck, and mistbound enters play (discard arcane cadence and bee bot)). La Capitan can’t play cards for one turn.

Use a Power: Load Brainstorm (draw robot reclamation, brainstorm, deal 2 damage to the ship[9] and la capitan[73]

Draw a Card: Platform Bot

End of Turn:

HP: 28

Hand: Robot Reclamation, Platform Bot, Arcane Cadence, Brainstorm

In Play:

Trash: Mistbound, Bee Bot, Raptor Bot, Arcane Cadence x2, brainstorm

addt’l effects: La capitan is mistbound.
